description: 4-tier cadence engine with doubling down, mode campagne, brand-safe defaults, and Creator Rewards preset

stories.title: Cadence presets read from DB and enforced in publish-scheduled
acceptance: distribution_settings.cadence_preset column exists (warmup|growth|farm|campaign)
publish-scheduled cron reads cadence_preset and enforces max posts/day and min spacing
warmup: 0 posts first 48h, then 1/day, 3h min spacing
growth: 1-2/day, 3h min spacing
farm: 3-4/day, 3h min spacing
stories.verify: npx tsc --noEmit && curl -s localhost:3000/api/cron/publish-scheduled -X POST -H 'x-api-key: test' | jq .error

stories.title: Campaign mode preset (5-8 posts/day, 2h spacing, single streamer)
acceptance: cadence_preset='campaign' enforces 5-8/day, 2h spacing
campaign mode only posts clips from a single streamer (configured in settings)
duration: 7 days max, then auto-reverts to farm

stories.title: Doubling down: breakout clip gets 3-5 variants across platforms
acceptance: When a post exceeds 3x median views, breakout-detector flags it
System generates 3-5 additional variants of the same source clip
Variants posted across all connected platforms within 24h

stories.title: Brand-safe content filter on autofarm
acceptance: content_risk clips never auto-published (existing)
New: profanity in Whisper transcript → flag content_risk='language'
User can override per-clip via distribution_settings.allow_risky_content

stories.title: Creator Rewards preset: 60s+ clips, description SEO, follow CTA
acceptance: When preset=creator_rewards, format score favors 60-180s clips
Captions always enabled, CTA follow always ON
Description includes niche keyword (existing caption engine)

stories.title: Multi-account support: different cadence per social_account
acceptance: cadence_preset can be set per social_account (not just per user)
Each account's posting history tracked independently
Never same clip on two accounts same day

stories.title: Smart Insights widget shows cadence summary
acceptance: Distribution hub shows current cadence preset name
Shows posts today / max today
Shows next available slot time

stories.title: Cadence preset selector in distribution settings
acceptance: User can switch between warmup/growth/farm/campaign in settings
Change persisted to distribution_settings.cadence_preset
Campaign mode requires confirmation (shows warning about volume)
